engine: Godot 4.6.3 / Linux X11 / Compatibility / Mesa llvmpipe / isolated profiles / Dummy audio. Native Windows not tested.

conditions.engine: Godot 4.6.3 Compatibility on Linux X11 with Mesa llvmpipe
conditions.load: Same real-input tutorial, pinned to cores 0–3 with two llvmpipe worker threads. Isolated new profile per run, dummy audio, screenshot writing and framebuffer readbacks disabled.
conditions.statistics: Milliseconds between process_frame signals including startup, stage transitions, actions, layout, rendering and scheduling. p95/p99 use nearest rank. Startup contributes a large single frame and is also reported separately.

startup_diagnostic.method: Independent single-core instrumentation. Godot wall clock sampled around tutorial setup and fixed-map navigation. These single-core costs are not directly comparable to the four-core input replay.
